articles.title: Meta is developing a prediction market app called ‘Arena’ as sector booms: NYT
articles.snippet: The app would let users forecast future events using a points-based system rather than cash wagers, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Bitcoin's recent drop below $60,000 signals Fed, ETF and AI pressures: Deutsche Bank
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's slump to its lowest level since late 2024 reflects a hawkish Federal Reserve, exchange-traded fund outflows and a shift of capital into AI, the bank said.

articles.title: Former Robinhood Crypto COO Tanya Denisova joins stablecoin issuer Agora as head of operations
articles.snippet: The former Robinhood Crypto executive will oversee operations as Agora scales its rapidly growing AUSD stablecoin business.

articles.title: In Clarity Act's final weeks, its path through U.S. Senate not getting much clearer
articles.snippet: Tough negotiations linger in several difficult arenas, but crypto's Washington lobbyists are flying in allies this week and still hoping for a July vote.

articles.title: Crypto market drops as Nasdaq tech selloff spills into digital assets
articles.snippet: Bitcoin lost 2.5% to $62,300 and ether fell more than 4% while $717 million in liquidations amplified losses across altcoins.
